allow_unencrypted_backups.name: Allow unencrypted backups
allow_unencrypted_backups.description: IMPORTANT: Syncing unencrypted backups to a remote location might expose sensitive data like secrets in plaintext! No backups without encryption flag will be handled, without explicit permission here. Turning this off will not remove any unencrypted copies transferred earlier

ftps_host.name: FTPs Host
ftps_host.description: IP address or domain hostname of FTPs server, use [brackets] for IPv6 addresses

ftps_port.name: FTPs Port
ftps_port.description: Port of FTPs server, usually 21 for explicit mode and 990 for implicit one

ftps_user.name: FTPs Username
ftps_user.description: Username to authenticate at FTPs server

ftps_password.name: FTPs Password
ftps_password.description: Password to authenticate at FTPs server

ftps_implicit.name: FTPs Implicit
ftps_implicit.description: Force implicit FTPs, if required, default 'off' as most servers use explicit

ftps_ca_file.name: FTPs Self-Signed Certificate
ftps_ca_file.description: Optional: File name of a PEM / CA certificate to verify the FTPs server, stored within this app's configuration folder, e.g. 'ftps_ca.pem'. Leave empty to use the system certificates. 'FTPs Host' above has to match the certificate.

ftps_check_hostname.name: FTPs Check Hostname
ftps_check_hostname.description: Verify FTPs server hostname, if you use a self-signed certificate disable this in case of issues

ftps_remote_dir.name: FTPs Path
ftps_remote_dir.description: Relative target folder at FTPs server, leave empty for login directory

ftps_sync_deletions.name: FTPs Sync Deletions
ftps_sync_deletions.description: Delete backups from FTPs server once they are removed locally

ftps_atomic_upload.name: FTPs Atomic Upload
ftps_atomic_upload.description: Upload with temporary name and rename once complete. Turn off only if renaming files is not allowed for the FTP user.
